name: Purple Heart Vets
description: Purple Heart Vets (PHV) is a violent street gang operating primarily on the northwest side of Detroit, Michigan. The gang promotes a "soldiers in battle" identity, with leaders rewarding members who commit acts of violence with Purple Heart medals. PHV has been involved in shootings, drug trafficking, firearms offenses, and unemployment insurance fraud. In August 2023, a federal grand jury indicted multiple PHV members on RICO conspiracy charges in the Eastern District of Michigan.
